'''Waleed Nagma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Monsolar/Legends|Monsolar]], where as a child he became infested by a [[Syrox]] [[Parasite/Legends|parasite]]. His attempts at having the parasite removed ended with him being incarcerated in the prison known as [[Cog Hive Seven]], where the parasite continued to grow inside of him. Nagma had another inmate, known as [[Dakarai Blirr|Zero]], smuggle in a bulb of [[Anzati snot garlic]], which he used to draw the creature out from within him, after which Zero [[Death/Legends|killed]] it. Nagma himself was later killed during a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] match in the prison.
